purpose: Use only reserved development seeds 329 and 330 to test whether the immutable Candidate39 fixed residual direction improves pre-latch CLOSE acquisition without introducing lift hacks, unsafe force, action saturation, or downstream success regression.

development_only.allowed_claim_if_all_gates_pass: The fixed direction is eligible for a separately preregistered formal A/B screen; it is not an accepted or deployable policy.
development_only.allowed_claim_if_any_gate_fails: Reject this fixed direction before formal screening.

fixed_intervention_contract.name: candidate39_fixed_episode_coherent_pre_latch_hand_residual
fixed_intervention_contract.candidate: Every treatment-assigned slot receives the exact same immutable fixed_z14; there is no per-slot latent redraw, sign flip, actor standard deviation, or learned update.
fixed_intervention_contract.control: Exact deterministic V6 action with zero residual.
fixed_intervention_contract.eligible_rows: option_active and public_latch==0 and never_previously_latched and 0<=close_age<32
fixed_intervention_contract.first_latch_retirement: The first public latch permanently retires the residual for the rest of the episode, including after any later latch release.
fixed_intervention_contract.pre_handoff_latch_retirement: A SEARCH-side latch before handoff also permanently retires the residual; a later trigger is legal but has zero intervention rows and is excluded from common-exposure analyses.
fixed_intervention_contract.arm_action: Exact V6 authority output and exact zero throughout CLOSE; the residual never changes any of the seven arm coordinates.
fixed_intervention_contract.hand_action: tanh(atanh(clamp(exact deterministic V6 hand14 action)) + bounded_fixed_delta14)

offline_fixed_direction_audit.domain: All 2711 saved eligible-window action rows in the sealed Candidate39 seed-327/328 development artifacts, counterfactually overlaid with the exact fixed direction.
offline_fixed_direction_audit.interpretation: The fixed direction stays inside the preregistered component and L2 budgets and introduced no near-boundary action on the complete offline window-row panel; this is a safety audit, not behavioral evidence.

assignment.ranking: Sort env_slot by SHA256 digest bytes with env_slot as the deterministic tie-breaker.
assignment.replicate_a: The first 32 ranked slots are treatment; the remaining 32 are control.
assignment.replicate_b: Bit-exact complement of replicate a, with no reranking and no fixed_z change.
assignment.per_seed_pairing: Each stable env_slot is observed once with fixed_z treatment and once with exact V6 control across complementary replicates.

non_evidence_smoke.purpose: Exercise the new fixed-direction routing, transition-latch clock, artifact publication, and action/safety audits before consuming reserved validation seeds.
must_pass_before_reserved_seed_collectio: arm, control, inactive, SEARCH, post-latch LIFT, and window retirement contracts remain exact
treated-triggered drop and unsafe-force counts are zero

prohibited_before_completion: changing fixed_z, scale, caps, handoff, horizon, assignment salt, estimator, gates, or run order after seeing the smoke or any seed-329/330 outcome
selecting or discarding episodes based on outcome
continuing an episode past the registered terminal truth to alter its label

estimands.contrast: fixed_z treatment minus exact V6 control
estimands.seed_weighting: Equal arithmetic mean of seed-329 and seed-330 estimates.

primary.name: conditional_latched_within_32_actions_delta
primary.domain: All first episodes that reached the immutable q=0.30 for four-frame handoff trigger in each run.
primary.estimator: Within each seed, Horvitz-Thompson treatment minus control using known propensity 0.5; then equal-weight the two seed estimates.
primary.outcome: First public latch occurs on a CLOSE action with close_age<32.

paired_common_exposure_sensitivity.domain: Same seed/env_slot triggered and produced at least one eligible window row in both complementary replicates; sticky-retired pre-handoff latch slots are excluded.
paired_common_exposure_sensitivity.role: Power and consistency diagnostic only; it does not replace the preregistered HT primary estimand.

episode_fields: stable env_slot, treatment, assignment rank, seed, and replicate
treatment plus exact fixed_z14; the fixed-direction payload hash is bound in metadata
trigger and first-latch clocks plus latched_within_32_actions
intervention row count and sticky-retirement truth
terminal success, failure, timeout, drop, unsafe-force, and unlatched-5cm truth
ever_grasped, true 20cm clearance, trajectory maximum force, and maximum true clearance
step_fields: obs115 and exact V6 raw mean hand14
close_age, public latch before action, residual active, and transition latch
transition grasp, grasp quality, hold quality, force, and true clearance
cross_replicate_checks: assignment masks are exact complements under the new fixed-direction salt
every treatment opportunity uses the exact manifest fixed_z and every control opportunity uses zero delta
SEARCH, V6 actor, task contract, bridge, frozen LIFT, source, and runtime assets are identical

every pre-trigger executed action is exact SEARCH with zero residual; trigger masks and clocks are measured independently per run and are not required to be bit-exact across nondeterministic GPU simulations
artifact_and_analysis_requirements.publish_rule: Publish the combined development report only after all four fixed-order artifacts independently and jointly pass strict schema, provenance, action-algebra, assignment, and complement validation.

collector_metadata_must_bind: exact source commit and source manifest
all immutable policy and runtime asset hashes
assignment contract, salt, mask, and run identity
required_simulation_free_tests: SHA assignment is exactly balanced, deterministic, and complementary for both reserved seeds
all treated slots receive the same exact fixed_z and all controls receive zero residual
32-action sticky window and first-latch retirement match the sealed Candidate39 contract
component/L2 caps, tanh action algebra, arm invariance, and inactive-row exactness hold
artifact validators reject altered manifest, fixed_z, assignment, checkpoint, source, and complementary evidence
analysis tests exercise every pass/fail boundary without using seed-329/330 simulator outcomes

decision_rule.if_all_gates_pass: Seal the four artifacts and development report, then write and commit a separate formal-acceptance plan and manifest before touching seeds 331-333. Passing this stage alone does not accept Candidate39.
decision_rule.if_any_gate_fails: Reject the fixed direction and do not run seeds 331-333 under this candidate. Do not reinterpret the fixed direction, thresholds, or seed-329/330 evidence.
decision_rule.formal_status: reserved and untouched; acceptance gates are intentionally not satisfied by this development plan
